headline: Nvidia value jumps nearly $1tn as tech rallies
pages: Nvidia's market value rose by nearly $1 trillion on Monday after the company reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Shares gained more than 31%, the Nasdaq climbed 6.5% and the S&P 500 rose 4.75%. Other chipmakers also surged, with Micron up 19% and AMD up nearly 7%. Tesla rose nearly 11.5%. Nvidia is worth close to $4 trillion again, but shares remain about 21% below a month ago. They fell sharply after the Democratic midterm win raised fears of tougher AI regulation, and dropped 13.7% on Friday amid a Reuters report, unconfirmed by the BBC, of an SEC probe into its accounting. Nvidia chips are central to the AI boom. Source: BBC News.
